title: Makeup Expiry and Rotation Watch
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skincare:routine expires_epoch=*
| eval days_to_expiry=round((expires_epoch-now())/86400,0)
| where days_to_expiry<60
| stats min(days_to_expiry) as closest_expiry, values(product_name) as products by routine_type
| sort closest_expiry
description: Surfaces beauty products that are near expiry so you can rotate or replace them before they go stale.
value: Expiry is both a cost and hygiene issue; an early watch avoids waste and skin irritation.
implementation: Store expiry dates on routine products and alert when they are within 60 days of expiry.
visualization: Table of routine types with nearest product expiry.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which beauty products are about to go out of date so you can use them or replace them in time.
